unknown_optional_rule: null plus nonempty unavailable_reasons[field], never infer hidden version/reasoning
tools_rule: tool_log always exists; no tools => explicit empty log and tools_used=[]; tool_versions records only observed versions; unavailable version needs explanation
fresh_rule: fresh_session_id distinct across attempts and from author/judge; fresh_mode=new_context_session; retain exact dispatched payload and infrastructure receipt R3 is a complete 36-new-session round, not selective repair of R2 attempts.
model_rule: model_requested is observable routing target, not claim of actual backend build
hash_rule: hash exact input and raw output bytes; judge checks files against hashes and frozen builder-inputs
acceptance_rule: validate_provenance is structural only; required logs must actually exist and hash-match before judge can PASS; unavailable required observation => INCONCLUSIVE
dispatch_rule: Before spawning any builder, save readable full outer payload including wrapper instructions, ENTRY bytes, case projection, target/model and fresh settings. Hash saved exact bytes before dispatch; record infrastructure and write timing. Do not reconstruct after output. input log alone is insufficient.
dispatch_verification: validate_provenance(receipt,evidence_root) verifies dispatch SHA-256 against actual bytes under declared evidence root and infrastructure record existence. One-argument form validates structure only. Independent judge confirms payload completeness and pre-spawn ordering from operator/infrastructure receipts.
